+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger implements the DatabasePinger interface for SQL Server.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server and executes a basic query to validate the connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+
+	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("server=%s;port=%d;user id=%s;database=%s;encrypt=disable", params.Host, params.Port, params.Username, params.DatabaseName)
+	db, err := sql.Open("sqlserver", dsn)
+	if err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if err := db.Close(); err != nil {
+			logrus.WithError(err).Info("failed to close connection in SQLServerPinger.Ping")
+		}
+	}()
+
+	if err := db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the connection was refused or the server is unreachable.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	var opErr *net.OpError
+	return errors.As(err, &opErr) && (errors.Is(opErr, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) || opErr.Timeout()) || errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED)
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports whether SQL Server rejected the login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err) == 18456
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports whether the requested database is unavailable.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err) == 4060
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error) int32 {
+	if err == nil {
+		return 0
+	}
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		return sqlErr.Number
+	}
+	var sqlErrPtr *mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErrPtr) && sqlErrPtr != nil {
+		return sqlErrPtr.Number
+	}
+	return 0
+}
